name: aloft-website
description: ALOFT Centralized Cooling Solutions — website (Next.js frontend, NestJS backend, PostgreSQL via Prisma).

scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:content && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aloft/content && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aloft/content && npm run test -w backend && npm run test:e2e -w backend
